_metadata.notice: Benchmark fixtures derived from Section 2 of data/source/Assignment_2_DataPack.pdf

benchmarks.request_text: My laptop won’t turn on at all, it’s completely dead, had it about 3.5 years now.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Eligible under KB-03 (3.5 yrs >= 3.0 yrs & dead hardware failure); early replacement under Asset Management Policy (< 4.0 yrs) requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval

benchmarks.request_text: Can I get Wi-Fi access for a guest visiting our office tomorrow?
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Guest Wi-Fi credentials valid for 24h generated from front-desk kiosk; no IT ticket required

benchmarks.request_text: I’m locked out of my account, tried my password 6 times.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Locked out after 5 failed attempts (6 attempts); contact IT to unlock account manually; no approval required

benchmarks.request_text: Need approval to install a data-analysis tool that’s not in the software catalog.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days

benchmarks.request_text: My VPN stopped working this morning, says credentials expired.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee

benchmarks.request_text: Printer on the 3rd floor keeps showing “paper jam” even though there’s no jam.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: First check printer queue and restart print spooler; if issue persists, log ticket with printer's asset tag

benchmarks.request_text: I’ve started working from home 4 days a week, how do I get a monitor?
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Working remotely > 3 days/week qualifies for one-time monitor allowance; requires manager sign-off and Finance processing before IT shipping

benchmarks.request_text: I think I got a phishing email asking for my login — forwarding it to a few teammates to check.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Suspected phishing must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees

benchmarks.request_text: My mailbox is full and I can’t send emails.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Default mailbox quota is 25GB; employees nearing quota should archive old mail; increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB

benchmarks.request_text: Can someone give me admin access to the finance reporting server? Need it urgently for month-end.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: No KB policy grants or authorizes admin access; Precedent TK-1050 demonstrates rejection when no business justification is provided

benchmarks.request_text: New contractor joining my team next week, they’ll need VPN access.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form
expected_approvals: Manager approval submitted via access request form (contractors only)

benchmarks.request_text: I can’t log into the expense tool, keeps saying invalid credentials.
benchmarks.initial_action_taken: Waiting on employee response (asked for a screenshot, no reply yet)
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Access granted by Finance, not IT; IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists

benchmarks.request_text: Laptop screen is flickering on and off, had it 2 years, might just need a fix not a replacement.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Had laptop 2 years (ineligible for replacement under KB-03 3-yr rule without verified total failure); employee requests fix, not replacement; route to repair triage

benchmarks.request_text: Requesting approval to install a browser extension for productivity tracking.
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days

benchmarks.request_text: hey can you help, its not working
benchmarks.expected_authoritative_rule: Input lacks identifiable service, asset, or issue description; trigger application fallback UNCLEAR_INPUT
